children: Shares of ESDS Software Solution hit the upper circuit for the third straight day on Tuesday, September 8, extending the sharp rally seen since its listing.
The stock rose 20% to Rs 1,308.05 per share, its upper circuit level, on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) at 12:49 pm. The company's market capitalisation stood at Rs 12,776.58 crore.
The stock has risen 154.09% over its IPO issue price of Rs 429 per share.

The company's equity shares debuted at Rs 757 per share on the NSE on September 4, reflecting a premium of 76.46% over the issue price. The stock later hit its upper circuit. On the BSE, it was listed at Rs 746.30, up 73.96% from the issue price.
The Rs 720 crore initial public offering was a fresh issue of 1.68 crore shares, with no offer for sale component.

Money raised to the tune of Rs 576 crore will be used to buy and install cloud computing and other equipment and infrastructure for data centres. The rest will be utilised for general corporate purposes.

"Our company expects that the listing of the equity shares on the stock exchanges will enhance our visibility and our brand image among our existing and potential customers and create a public market for the equity shares of our company," ESDS Solution said in its red herring prospectus.
The issue was subscribed 135.88 times during the three-day bidding window. It received bids for 1,67,85,63,340 shares against 1,23,52,942 shares on offer.

Qualified institutional investors led the bidding, subscribing to their portion 261.51 times. The quota for non-institutional investors was booked 192.94 times, while the retail portion was subscribed 39.64 times.

Prior to the IPO, the company mobilised Rs 206 crore from anchor investors, including Quant Mutual Fund, Bandhan Mutual Fund, Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund, Bajaj General Insurance, Sanshi Fund-I, Samco Mutual Fund, CP Capital and Meru Investment Fund PCC-Cell 1.
ESDS Software Solution is an artificial intelligence-enabled cloud, managed services, data centre infrastructure and software solutions provider.

title: ESDS Software Solution surges 20% for third straight day; stock up 205% from IPO price
